name: What are common causes of low water pressure in homes?

mainEntity.name: What are common causes of low water pressure in homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low water pressure can stem from various issues, including mineral buildup in pipes, corroded or clogged pipes, a faulty pressure regulator, or leaks in your plumbing system. Sometimes, the problem originates outside your home, such as municipal supply issues. To identify the exact cause, a plumber will typically inspect your pipes, check the main water shut-off valve, and test the pressure regulator. Understanding the cause is crucial for choosing the correct repair, ranging from simple valve adjustments to more complex repiping.
acceptedAnswer.description: Low water pressure can be caused by pipe buildup, corrosion, a faulty regulator, or leaks. A plumber can diagnose and address the issue.
